models.Name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.Description: Flagship reasoning, coding, tools, vision and video. Ollama qwen3.8:latest equivalent.

models.Name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.Description: Fast 9B reasoning and coding model with vision and tool support; designed for responsive local VS Code agents.

models.Name: Ornith 1.5 9B
models.Description: Community coding/reasoning fine-tune of Qwen3.5 9B (MIT). Publisher-reported improvements over base Qwen3.5 9B are not independently verified here; same VRAM and context profile, so it drops in as an A/B option. Needs the Vulkan or llama.cpp ROCm (latest) backend (AMD's ROCm 7.2.1 package cannot load it); Vulkan lost the GPU in long sessions on an RX 9070 XT.

models.Name: Gemma 4 12B
models.Description: Google's April 2026 model with vision and tool calling. Not yet tested with Copilot Agent mode by this project. Needs the Vulkan or llama.cpp ROCm (latest) backend; AMD's ROCm 7.2.1 package cannot load it.

models.Name: Gemma 3 12B Vision
models.Description: Strong general assistant and image understanding with a balanced memory footprint.

models.Name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.Description: Mixture-of-experts model, 35B total and about 3B active per token (Apache 2.0, Unsloth quant). The Q4 file is about 20 GiB, so on a 16 GB card its experts have to sit in system RAM; speed on this PC is not measured yet. Experimental until a real run says otherwise.

models.Name: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B
models.Description: Community coding/reasoning mixture-of-experts model, 35B total and about 3B active (MIT). About 20 GiB at Q4, so its experts have to sit in system RAM. Publisher claims are not verified here. Its 9B sibling needs the MTP-capable Vulkan or llama.cpp ROCm (latest) build; this one is assumed to as well until a load proves otherwise.

models.Name: Qwen3 8B
models.Description: High-quality Q8 reasoning and tool use; excellent quality per byte on modern Ryzen CPUs.

models.Name: Llama 3.1 8B
models.Description: Proven general-purpose instruct model with broad ecosystem support and modest memory use.

models.Name: Gemma 3 4B Vision
models.Description: Compact multimodal model for 8 GB systems; fast on Ryzen integrated graphics.

models.Name: Qwen3 4B
models.Description: Small, fast reasoning and tool-use model; ideal for 8–16 GB systems and CPU fallback.
